rows.detail: Read every checkpoint as UTF-8 text.
Reject repeated object member names at every nesting level.
Reject NaN during input parsing.
Reject Infinity during input parsing.
Reject -Infinity during input parsing.
Disallow non-standard non-finite output serialization.
Any strict parse error invalidates the checkpoint.
Write reports through same-directory temporary file and atomic replacement.
slot_id must be height_difference_3.
Both declared and resolved blob SHA must equal bb48164e...edb8.
Canonical object type must be blob.
Full canonical byte stream must expose a 64-hex SHA256.
Streamed source size must be positive.
features array marker must be found.
features array must close normally.
Exactly 92283 features must be scanned.
Entire feature array must parse.
Entire canonical object must be hashed.
Exactly three canonical Point rows required.
Rows must be parcel_61523, parcel_61524, parcel_61525 in order.
Output parcel IDs must be unique.
Each target ID must occur exactly once in the 92283-feature source.
Longitude must be finite and between -180 and 180.
Latitude must be finite and between -90 and 90.
Canonical and reconciliation projections must match exactly.
Canonical and website projections plus rows_visible=3 must match exactly.
Epoch probe must resolve the same exact canonical blob.
Epoch probe errors must be empty.
UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED remains valid pending reviewed epoch evidence.
Watchdog process names must be unique.
Timeout and killed process-tree counters must match process rows.
Chain steps and state must equal watchdog process rows and state.
The same recovery task ID cannot increment retry_count twice.
Recovery sequence must equal current retry_count plus one.
Retry count cannot exceed three.
Remaining recovery tasks are disabled after strict success or exhaustion.
